primary_effort: Maintain force acceptance and rebound quality through one additional jump in a short vertical sequence.
readiness_gate: Use the four-jump route only after actual 2 × 3 execution at the chosen fixed amplitude shows 4/4 organized transitions and 2/2 final holds, acceptable subsequent response and current readiness. A height merely prescribed in Class 9 is not qualified. Without evidence, use two sets of three instead. E4 forward rebounds remain independently gated by actual forward-rebound control and recovery; otherwise use the held-forward replacement. Hold strength load and all distances.

explosive.name: Countermovement Jump to Stick
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 jumps. 20 s between jumps; 60 s before E2.**
explosive.job: Retain a small bilateral braking reference before single-leg acceptance. Use a controllable vertical jump, coordinated ankle/knee/hip yielding and a 2 s hold. Lower height for stepping or trunk collapse.

explosive.name: Ankle Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 4 low jumps**, continuous. **90 s before E3.**
explosive.job: Keep a short ankle-rhythm entry while allocating two more potential contacts to the primary sequence. Stay tall and centered with soft knees; settle the fourth contact. Lower amplitude or stop for knee pumping or lost rhythm.

explosive.name: Repeated Vertical Jump — four connected jumps
explosive.dose: **2 × 4 jumps = 8 landings / 6 transitions. 120 s between sets and before E4.**
explosive.job: **Primary anchor:** maintain the same receiving/rebound organization through one additional jump per short sequence. Use a previously qualified moderate height and natural arm swing; keep the fourth jump as organized as the earlier ones and hold its landing 2 s. End the sequence if contact becomes a gathering dip, travel increases or the knee/pelvis collapses; do not chase completion.
explosive.kind: moderate bilateral vertical rebound; longer short sequence

explosive.name: Repeated Broad Jump — two connected jumps
explosive.dose: **2 × 2 jumps = 4 landings / 2 forward rebound transitions. 120 s between sets and before E5.**
explosive.job: Consolidate a separately qualified forward landing-to-takeoff pattern at a small dose. Use modest displacement and natural arm swing, continuous reversal without a gather and a 2 s final stop. Shorten distance or use held broad jumps if reaching or uncontrolled travel appears.

explosive.name: Lateral Bound — stick landing
explosive.dose: **1 × 2 receiving landings per leg = 4 bounds.** Alternate sides, **20 s between bounds; 90 s before E6.**
explosive.job: Keep lateral single-leg force acceptance without adding lateral return demand while vertical amplitude is the candidate change. Use the familiar small distance and hold each landing 2 s. Shorten for knee collapse, pelvis drop or corrective hops.

explosive.name: Single-Leg Pogo in Place
explosive.dose: **1 × 3 low hops per leg = 6 hops. 60 s between legs; 90 s before Section 3.**
explosive.job: Keep a minimal but real one-leg ankle rhythm exposure while directional practice shares the session. Stay centered over the foot with a softly organized knee; settle the third hop. Use lower amplitude/support or stop if alignment or rhythm is lost.

replacement_routes.description: Listed route: 28 landings = 18 bilateral + 10 single-leg, 15 transitions, 46 limb contacts. E3 three-jump hold: 26 landings = 16 bilateral + 10 single-leg, 13 transitions, 42 limb contacts; E3 time 252 s versus 254.

E4 forward-stop replacement keeps the selected E3 route’s landing count and removes 2 transitions: full E3 gives 28 landings/13 transitions; held E3 gives 26/11. It adds 30 s to E4, included in the upper estimate.

next_intended_job: Class 11 refines the established lateral-return task with familiar amplitudes and short sequences; the earlier single-leg dose is an option only if actual response supports it.
